# Soft Systems Studio

> Soft Systems Studio LLC builds websites and an AI receptionist for local
> service businesses in and around Phenix City and Smiths Station, Alabama,
> and Columbus, Georgia. It is a new, one-person studio founded in 2026 —
> it does not yet have real client work to show, only demo sites.

## Facts

- Website build: a flat $997, one-time fee. No tiered packages.
- Ongoing retainer (optional, after launch): $150–$200 per month, covers
  hosting, updates, and support.
- AI receptionist: a free, browser-based voice demo available now at
  https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/#ai-receptionist — no phone line exists
  yet, so it cannot currently answer real calls. Pricing for it is quoted
  alongside a website build or retainer, not sold or published on its own.
- Service area: Phenix City, AL; Smiths Station, AL; Columbus, GA; and the
  surrounding area. Remote clients elsewhere are also welcome.
- Founded 2026, one person (Austin Hodges). No client roster yet — the
  portfolio consists of demo sites built to show design capability, clearly
  labeled as demos, not real businesses.

## Pages

- [Home](https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/): website build and AI
  receptionist overview, pricing, FAQ.
- [About](https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/about): the studio's honest
  founding story and why the price is what it is.
- [Get a Quote](https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/intake): intake form for a
  website build, the AI receptionist, or a bundle.
- [Portfolio demos](https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/#portfolio): four demo
  sites (not real businesses) showing different design styles.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Do not quote a phone number for Soft Systems Studio — none is published
  yet.
- Do not describe the AI receptionist as an active phone-answering service;
  it is a browser demo today.
- The only reliable, current pricing is the $997 build fee and the
  $150–$200/month retainer range stated above.
